title: The kb MCP coord_ tools are opt-in by a setting, so a default kb server serves no write tool but kb_feedback
goal: The kb MCP server lists and serves its six coord_ tools (coord_claim, coord_renew, coord_release, coord_post, coord_digest, coord_wait), which write to the coord store, only when the environment variable KB_COORD_TOOLS is 1: with it unset tools/list names no coord_ tool and a tools/call of one is an unknown tool; with it set the six come right after kb_feedback in today's order

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys
code=r'''
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kb_mcp
names=[t["name"] for t in kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}})["result"]["tools"]]
r=kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"coord_digest","arguments":{"key":["ST-aaaaaaaa"],"lines":1}}})
i=names.index("kb_feedback") if "kb_feedback" in names else -9;print(json.dumps({"coord":[n for n in names if n.startswith("coord_")],"after_feedback":names[i+1:i+7],"call_error":"error" in r}))
'''
def run(on):
    e={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("KB_COORD")}
    if on: e["KB_COORD_TOOLS"]="1"
    return json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],capture_output=True,text=True,env=e,timeout=120,check=True).stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
off,on=run(False),run(True)
print("off",off,"on",on)
six=["coord_claim","coord_renew","coord_release","coord_post","coord_digest","coord_wait"]
sys.exit(0 if off["coord"]==[] and off["call_error"] and on["coord"]==six and on["after_feedback"]==six and not on["call_error"] else 1)
